answer: An operator running 67 keys therefore pays for 67 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the ridge quota and the quartz admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 9 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole farm at once. Since the throttle counters live in the cipher ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
